## POST `/103/wlp/performance_impact`

**Tier:** T1+ (check: some POSTs are actions)

| `auto_resolve_conflicts` | boolean | If not specified or set to false, any configuration-related conflicts encountered on a candidate system when running a performance impact test will prevent that system from being recommended. If used with details flag… |

**Responses:** `200` OK → `performance_impact_result` · `400` Bad Request · `401` Unauthorized · `403` Forbidden · `500` Internal Server Error

## PUT `/103/wlp/symmetrix/{symmetrixId}`

|---|---|---|---|---|

**Request body** (required): `dataExclusionParam`

|---|---|---|

| `excludedBucket` | array of integer (int32) | Specifying bucket values results in recurring (non-expiring) data exclusions. A bucket is a four hour time window. A week has 42 buckets (0-indexed). Bucket 0 is Sunday 12am-4am, 1 is Sunday 4am-8am, etc. |

**Responses:** `200` OK → `wlpSymmetrix` · `202` Accepted · `400` Bad Request · `401` Unauthorized · `403` Forbidden · `409` Conflict · `500` Internal Server Error

## GET `/103/wlp/symmetrix/{symmetrixId}/utilization`

**Tier:** T0  

This call queries the system-component utilization values for the past two weeks. The utilization values shown are normalized to a best practice limit for each component type. By default, only most limiting (highest utilization) value is shown for a given timestamp.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `symmetrixId` | path | string | yes | The System ID |
| `bucket` | query | string |  | The bucket Id. Display all component utilization values for a given bucketId. A bucket is a four hour time window. A week has 42 buckets (0-indexed). Bucket 0 is Sunday 12am-4am, 1 is Sunday 4am-8am, etc |
| `backEndOnly` | query | boolean |  | Only show utilizations for back end components. Only back end components impact headroom calculations |

**Responses:** `200` OK → `maxArrayComponentUtilizationList` · `400` Bad Request · `401` Unauthorized · `403` Forbidden · `500` Internal Server Error · `503` Service Unavailable
